cards.hint: Think about what pulls objects toward the ground.
options: the gravitational attraction of the earth
cards.quote: Weight is the force generated by the gravitational attraction of the earth on any object.
cards.stem: What generates weight on any object?

cards.hint: Remember if gravity needs contact to pull.
cards.quote: The gravitational force is a field force; the source of the force does not have to be in physical contact with the object to generate a force.
cards.stem: How does gravitational force act without touching its source?

cards.hint: Look for the lighter weight at high altitude.
cards.stem: In the example, what does the airplane weigh at altitude?

cards.hint: Think about touching air to make lift and drag.
options: in physical contact with the air
cards.quote: Aerodynamic forces are mechanical forces and the object has to be in physical contact with the air which generates the force.
cards.stem: What is required for aerodynamic forces to act on an object?
